answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new agent to earn a decaying reputation score through verifiable completed work before it can transact at full value. A fresh identity starts in a probationary tier with tiny transfer caps, like a raven learning to fly in a tundra wind: it must complete many small, independently checked jobs, each attested by unrelated peers. A nebula of fake accounts cannot shortcut this because reputation accrues slowly, costs compute and fees per job, and collapses to zero if any attested fraud is found, so cloning identities multiplies cost, not profit.
